name: Phuzzle
mechanicSummary: Visual arrangement: jigsaw puzzle — drag, drop, and snap pieces on a board; optional daily challenge and themed packs.
description: Solo puzzle game: short-session jigsaw play with clear completion (all pieces placed). Daily puzzle, quick play catalog, and puzzle packs. Progress for in-flight games can resume after refresh; completed runs are recorded with time, moves, and related stats.

persistence.inProgressPuzzle: Resumable — play state is stored locally (and optionally synced for signed-in features). Refreshing or re-opening the app can restore an active puzzle from the play screen or resume prompts where implemented.
persistence.sessionOnlyModes: None required for core jigsaw flow; treat a 'session' as one puzzle until complete or abandoned.
persistence.completion: Completion is detected when all pieces are placed correctly; win UI confirms solve. Metrics (e.g. time, moves) are recorded for the run; daily completions additionally feed streak/album logic when applicable.

browserSupport: Modern evergreen browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) on desktop and mobile; touch and pointer input.
embedNotes: If the Games host loads Phuzzle in an iframe, the deployment must allow that origin via Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors (or equivalent). Coordinate the parent origin with the hosting team; see docs/GAMES_SURFACE.md.
